title: Keep shell-loaded logics from importing component files that pull in heavy logic
answers: Why is liquidjs or dompurify in the main authenticated bundle?
Where should shared option lists for taxonomic filter live?
How to keep the shell eager JS small when a logic imports from a component file
body:
taxonomicFilterLogic and buildTaxonomicGroups load on every logged-in page (authenticated shell). They must import only light modules.
- Import product event option lists from `scenes/hog-functions/filters/productEventFilterOptions` (getProductEventFilterOptions, getProductEventPropertyFilterOptions, getProductEventPropertyValues), never from `HogFunctionFiltersInternal.tsx`.
- `HogFunctionFiltersInternal.tsx` imports `hogFunctionConfigurationLogic`, which drags in liquidjs, dompurify and survey utils. Importing anything from it puts ~153 KiB on the shell.
- Pattern: when a shell-loaded file needs a pure helper or constant from a component file, move it to a dependency-free `.ts` module and import from there.
- Check with a production build and the esbuild metafile.
applies: frontend/src/lib/components/TaxonomicFilter and any module loaded eagerly on the authenticated shell
